supportChat.defaultAgentMessage: Hi, you are speaking with Cluega's AI Agent. How can I help you today?

revenueEfficiency.title: Question 1
revenueEfficiency.question: How does Cluega AI help my team improve revenue efficiency?
revenueEfficiency.response:
Hi! I am Cluega's AI assistant. Through natural-language interaction, Cluega lets your team directly “talk to data”.

We integrate cross-platform advertising, messaging, and order data into Cluega AI. Your team no longer needs to manually organize reports. AI automatically scans opportunities, diagnoses issues, and generates executable decision recommendations. This can shorten operational reviews that used to take hours down to 30 seconds.

To learn more, contact us. Please {link} to leave your contact information.

crossPlatformData.title: Question 2
crossPlatformData.question: How does Cluega process and understand my complex cross-platform data?
crossPlatformData.response:
This is where our core technology comes in. Cluega uses the MCP protocol (Model Context Protocol) as the communication hub.

After you connect TikTok, Meta, or Shopify, the system automatically structures these fragmented data points and builds a work context with “brand awareness”. This means AI can not only see the numbers, but also understand the business logic behind them, so it can provide optimization recommendations that truly match your brand tone.

firstProject.title: Question 3
firstProject.question: As a first-time user, how can I quickly launch my first AI operations project?
firstProject.response:
Getting started is very simple. It only takes three steps:

a. App authorization: connect your advertising and social accounts from the “Capabilities” menu.

b. Enter an instruction: type “Analyze yesterday's performance for me” or “Create a promotion plan” in the chat box.

c. Confirm execution: review the plan recommended by AI and click “Execute”.

Register now to receive 1,000 starter Tokens. {link}.
